decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The extract system shall comprise of a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-carbon and carbon filter. The duct as shown on the approved plans, shall terminate one metre above the eaves or one metre above any openable windows of adjacent premises whichever is the higher.The duct shall terminate pointing upwards. A cowl shall be omitted and lightweight flaps or other covers, which open when the system is powered, should be fitted. The system shall be routinely serviced.The duct shall not exceed the dimensions shown on the submitted plans and shall not be located other than as shown on the plans without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority, obtained through submission of a planning permission application.

Condition : 5 - The extract system shall not cause an increase in background noise level (BNL) in the vicinity. When the system is operating at a maximum, the noise levels shall be 10bB(A) lower than the BNL. To achieve this the following measures shall be adopted.1.	The fan unit and filters shall be located within the building, or if it is to be located outside the building, they shall be housed within an acoustic enclosure2.	Silencers shall be provided to one or both sides of the fan as necessary3.	Ducting shall be configured to minimise turbulent air flow with no acute bends or duct constrictions4.	Ducting shall be circular5.	The fan shall be isolated from inlet and outlet ducting using flexible couplings6.	The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts 7.	The ducting shall be isolated from the building structure using anti-vibration mountings and a packing material where it passes through any solid structure
Condition : 6 - The extraction and noise control systems as detailed in Conditions 4 and 5 above shall be full implemented before the kitchen is used.
Condition : 7 - The area to the west and north of the new toilet extension shall not be fenced and shall be porous paving.
description: External and internal refurbishments including the erection of a single storey side extension, incorporating extended dining area and new toilet block, new covered area and replacement of existing gate and fence and associated landscaping.
